privacyAndLegalReviewer.note: Not independent counsel. This is the business owner reviewing his own product against the privacy and legal checklist. Recorded as an owner self-review so the assurance level is not overstated.

independentReleaseApprover.note: Same person as the production key custodian. The independence control required by GATE-RELEASE is NOT satisfied.

representativeStaffTesters.note: GATE-UAT still needs named staff for the cashier/maker and manager/checker rows of the role matrix. The owner can only fill the owner/admin row.

independenceException.control: GATE-RELEASE requires a named production-key custodian and an independent release approver, who must not be the same person.
independenceException.reason: Single-owner business. The owner holds the signing key and is also the only available release authority.
independenceException.ownerDirection: Sagar directed on 2026-08-22 that he serve as production key custodian and release approver, after the independence requirement and its consequence were raised and explained.
independenceException.riskAccepted: No second person will verify that the signed artifact matches what was reviewed, that prerequisite gates were genuinely closed, or that the carried exceptions were understood before release. The separation-of-duties control that normally catches a custodian signing the wrong artifact, or waving through an unmet gate, is absent. Any later reviewer, auditor, acquirer or regulator examining this release will see a self-approved release.
doesNotClaim: This is not an independent release approval
The register must not report the independence control as satisfied
This does not waive any prerequisite gate
independenceException.reopenCondition: If a second person becomes available before release, they should perform the release approval and this exception can be withdrawn.
mitigationsAvailable: Have a non-custodian second person countersign the artifact hash even if they are not a formal approver
Keep the signing receipt and the release decision as separate dated records rather than one combined statement

consequenceForGateRelease: GATE-RELEASE can be closed when the signing and release evidence exists, but it must close carrying this independence exception in its decision record, not as a clean pass.
stillUnfilled: Named representative staff testers for GATE-UAT
